title: Buni buyurtma qilmang — 7 ta taqiq
caption: 🚫 Buni chetdan buyurtma qilmang — posilka qaytadi Ko'pchilik bilmay oladi, keyin bojxonada ushlanib qoladi: 1️⃣ Elektron sigaret, vape va suyuqliklari — olib kirish taqiqlangan (O'RQ-844, 37-modda) 2️⃣ Lazer ko'rsatkich — taqiqlangan (VM 50-son, 20.02.2013) 3️⃣ Dron — ruxsatnomasiz taqiqlangan (VM 658-son, 2-band; VM 801-son) 4️⃣ Ratsiya — EMMM ruxsatnomasi kerak (VM 801-son, Nizom 98-band) 5️⃣ Elektroshok — pochtada taqiqlangan; olib kirish faqat IIV ruxsati bilan (O'RQ-550, 15-modda) 6️⃣ Urug', ko'chat, meva va sabzavot — xalqaro pochtada taqiqlangan 7️⃣ Alkogol va tamaki — pochta va kuryer orqali taqiqlangan (VM 244-son, 1-ilova) 💡 Alohida qadoqlangan litiy batareyalar ham pochtada qabul qilinmaydi — batareya qurilma ichida bo'lishi kerak. 📄 6-band va batareya — Pochta aloqasi xizmatlarini ko'rsatish qoidalari, 3-ilova. Barcha hujjatlar lex.uz'da. 📲 Tovaringizni ilovada tekshiring ➖➖➖ @Pochtam_shopo #taqiq
prompt:
Create a vertical 4:5 cover image for a Telegram channel post. Clean, modern 3D-minimal style, calm and trustworthy. Pure white background with one large soft lavender (#EEEEFC) rounded shape behind the upper half.

1) Top-left: a small solid indigo (#4F46E5) rounded pill with white bold text "#taqiq".
2) Center: an open matte cardboard parcel box; floating above it a small vape pen, a laser pointer, a mini drone and a walkie-talkie, all in matte grey, with a bold crimson prohibition circle (circle with a diagonal bar) in front of them. Render it as a soft 3D clay illustration with matte surfaces in white and indigo (#4F46E5) with small touches of crimson (#E11D48); soft studio lighting, gentle shadows, generous space around it.
3) Below the illustration: a large bold near-black (#11111B) headline, at most two lines: "Buni buyurtma qilmang"
4) Under the headline, a smaller medium-grey line: "Posilka bojxonada qaytadi"
5) Bottom, above a thin light divider: left bold near-black "@Pochtam_shopo".

One geometric sans-serif font family throughout (Poppins / Montserrat style). Generous whitespace. Render every piece of text EXACTLY as written, spelled correctly, with straight apostrophes; numbers use spaces as thousand separators. No other text, no logos, no brand marks, no watermarks.
notes: Ratsiya istisnosi (5 Vt gacha, 26965–27860 kGs) joy yetmagani uchun yozilmadi — kerak bo'lsa izohda javob bering.
